text: A clearance sale. Dinner sets usually run thirty to sixty dollars.
Some students saw twenty-four pieces. All perfect.
Others saw forty. The same twenty-four, plus cups and saucers. But nine were broken.
The perfect set? About thirty-three dollars.
The bigger set, thirty-one good pieces? About twenty-three.
But side by side, the bigger set wins.
Judged alone, your eye counts what's broken, not what's good.
More good dishes. Lower price. Now you know why.
